authority: spec/08_SEWCP-900_RF_Feedthrough_Bracket.md Rev A (FROZEN) - RS-D01..RS-D07, section 6 (OFHC C10100, formed R20, silver 8-13 um direct on copper per DR-7)

scope.bounded: The formed strap solid: 50.0 wide x 0.50 thick, developed 180.0, S-form compliance path R20 from the 8.0 feedthrough level up to the chuck terminal level. Terminal bolt holes 2x O6.6 at 25 centres in the chuck-end pad.
scope.modelling_conventions: DECISION (design agent): the compliance path is modelled as the neutral S - flat 58.6 at z=8, 90 deg up-arc R20, 90 deg reverse arc R20, flat 58.6 at z=48 - closing RS-D03 = 180.0 developed exactly; the formed part's +/-2 tolerance absorbs the difference from the as-installed flexure, which is the part's purpose (RS-D05). Only the chuck-end pad holes are modelled; the feedthrough end clamps. Plating (RS-D08/D09), edge radii (RS-D11) and pad flatness (RS-D10) are process/drawing callouts.
scope.open_state: SEWCP-904 shroud envelope has no dimensional authority in spec/08 (material, grooves and assembly gaps only) - recorded as a requirement gap for the drawing stage; not invented here.

requirements.statement: 50.0 x 0.50 strip, developed 180.0, formed R20 S-compliance from z=8 to z=48: flats 58.6 each, two 90 deg arcs of 31.4 each.
2x O6.6 terminal bolt holes at 25 centres in the chuck-end pad, through the 0.5 strip, centred 9 mm from the strap end.

drills.rationale: Pad hole 1; vertical through the flat pad - modelled as a short symmetric drill normal to the pad.

requirements.statement: Blank, deburr R0.5, single R20 mandrel form, anneal, pickle, silver 8-13 um DIRECTLY on copper (no nickel underplate - DR-7), flatten pads to 0.05 TIR, 4-wire <= 3 mOhm.

interfaces.nature: 2x M6 at 25 centres onto the plate's rf taps (98.73/111.27 - verified)
